req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-022 requires HTTP 422 when firstName is empty string. We need: (1) a positive case proving a valid non-empty firstName yields 201, (2) a negative case proving empty string firstName yields exactly 422, (3) a boundary case proving a single-character firstName (length=1, the minimum non-empty boundary) yields 201 while empty string (length=0) yields 422. Additional cases cover whitespace-only firstName and null firstName to maximise mutation kill rate by asserting exact status codes and distinguishing adjacent values.

actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid payload where firstName is a non-empty string
expected: Response body contains firstName matching the submitted value
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-022: valid firstName must NOT trigger 422
EP: non-empty firstName belongs to the valid equivalence partition
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Carlos"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Tevez"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_empty_string_vs_single_char_boundary_contrast():
    payload_empty = {
        "firstName": "",
        "lastName": "Boundary",
        "squadNumber": 95,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r_empty = client.post("/players/", json=payload_empty)
    assert r_empty.status_code == 422

    payload_single = {
        "firstName": "B",
        "lastName": "Boundary",
        "squadNumber": 96,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r_single = client.post("/players/", json=payload_single)
    assert r_single.status_code == 201
    assert r_single.json()["firstName"] == "B"

test_post_player_empty_string_vs_single_char_boundary_contrast()
